stops.name: Enns
stops.quote: You can really experience the Gesäuse National Park on foot or by raft on the Enns.
stops.english: You can really experience the Gesäuse National Park on foot or by raft on the Enns.

stops.name: Johnsbach
stops.quote: While the common sandpiper breeds next to the gravel banks of the rivers Enns and Johnsbach, the pretty feathered pink, an endemite of the northern Limestone Alps, grows on the slopes of the harsh and unapproachable mountains.
stops.english: While the common sandpiper breeds next to the gravel banks of the rivers Enns and Johnsbach, the pretty feathered pink, an endemite of the northern Limestone Alps, grows on the slopes of the harsh and unapproachable mountains.
